audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleeds from tradeGood/tradeBad that don't cover the actual kit interactions. Three applicable interactions from missingInteractions are absent from the page: Bramble Smash (Q) grounds Zenith Blade (E), Twisted Advance (W) goes untargetable mid-dash so burst on it whiffs, and Sap Magic (P) sustain needs Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: Grounding on Leona's dash and Maokai's untargetable window are decisive, concrete mechanics the current text never states; the cooldowns field is pure prose with no timers to plan around.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns (Twisted Advance 14/13/12/11/10s, Nature's Grasp 130/110/90s, Bramble Smash 7-5s with grounding note), and rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d to state the dash-range bait and the untargetable-dodges-burst interaction instead of the duplicated trade lines.
